name: Training Ray Marching and Integration
aliases: Training Ray Marching and Integration — NeRF Forward Pass
definition: Performs volume rendering for training, including ray generation, adaptive marching with occupancy grid pruning, neural network evaluation, and alpha compositing.
summary: Training Ray Marching and Integration is the differentiable forward pass that synthesizes RGB images from a neural radiance field for gradient-based optimization, distinguished by its inclusion of adaptive sampling and occupancy grid pruning steps specific to the training loop.
